title: Machine learning-guided genetic algorithm prioritises NiFe/NiS oxygen evolution catalysts
summary: A machine learning-guided genetic algorithm with exploration and exploitation modes prioritised Ni-Fe-based catalysts, and NiFe/NiS catalysts were synthesised by plasma-assisted electrodeposition. The abstract reports oxygen evolution overpotentials of 219 mV at 10 mA cm-2 and 315 mV at 1000 mA cm-2. Comparison with benchmarks and the number of candidates tested are not stated in the abstract.

evidence.tested: Synthesis and electrochemical measurement of a prioritised NiFe/NiS catalyst.
evidence.unknown: Benchmark comparison and number of candidates tested not stated in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning model guiding a genetic algorithm to prioritise catalyst compositions.
